content: No mature/widely-adopted JS/TS library provides UR-specific analytical 6-DOF IK. glumb/kinematics exists but has unclear robot-chain constraints, minimal recent activity, no UR-specific validation. Standard practice: hand-roll closed-form IK using published UR DH parameters (Hawkins 2013 analytic solution, widely ported) or a generic numerical IK (CCD/FABRIK/Jacobian) against urdf-loader's joint chain.
